hook.name: BoardHook
hook.description: A token-launch hook that manages a FairLaunch mechanism: it gates swaps temporally until a configurable launch timestamp, enforces an optional Merkle-proof allowlist during the fair launch window, intercepts swap input/output via BeforeSwapDelta to sell tokens from a one-sided position, and captures custom swap fees redistributed to protocol, token creators, referrers, and a Muse manager via AfterSwapDelta.
